My featured projects (the same ones on https://jeremehancock.com).
`cat` any of them for details:

Want more? The other fun stuff (AI experiments, games, and

>> https://dumbprojects.com <<
Everything else: https://github.com/jeremehancock
marquee.md:
A self-hosted poster manager for Plex. Swap the artwork for
any movie, show, season, or collection, and lock it in so Plex
won't overwrite it.
glimpse.md:
Share your Plex, Jellyfin, or Emby library as a browsable wall
of posters. People just open a link: no account, no app, and
no access to your server.
cinemetric.md:
A Claude Code plugin for Plex. Ask Claude about your library,
server health, or who's been watching. Read-only, so nothing
on your server is changed.
clix.md:
A Plex media player that lives entirely in your terminal.
Search and play your movies, shows, and music without ever
leaving the command line.
leafmd.md:
A markdown editor for Linux that's simple on purpose. Read
your document formatted like GitHub, flip to the raw text to
edit, or see both at once.
random-goat.md:
Exactly what it sounds like: a delightfully pointless source
of random goat GIFs whenever you need one. Share your favorite
or embed it on your site.
dumbprojects.md:
